guidanceConsulted.query: responsive API reference documentation page with data tables and code blocks on narrow mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing; wrap potentially-wide content (tables) in overflow containers; set min-inline-size:0 / overflow-wrap on unbreakable content; use logical properties; reserve space with aspect-ratio/explicit dimensions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} around every data table, overflow-wrap:anywhere on table cells and the h1, <wbr> in long interface headings, explicit iframe width/height. Exception: no container queries — the shared editorial design system's single-column measure already fits the reference format.

guidanceConsulted.query: embedding live interactive demo iframe in documentation page responsively with fixed aspect ratio and lazy loading
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native loading=lazy on below-the-fold iframes; always set explicit width/height (or aspect-ratio) so the browser reserves space and avoids CLS; give the iframe a title.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the CPS embed iframe carries loading=lazy, width=720 height=480, max-width:100%, and a descriptive title.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible reference documentation structure headings landmarks data tables iframe embeds
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic HTML first: one h1, logical heading order, main landmark, th scope on table headers, captions for data tables, titled iframes, visible focus inherited from the design system.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single h1 + main landmark on all four pages, scope=col on compat/failure table headers, <caption> on data tables, titled iframe, byline/nav consistent with the site shell.

guidanceConsulted.query: lazy-loading iframes embedded live demo dimensioned to avoid layout shift CLS (fresh npx modern-web-guidance@latest search, cycle-17 re-verification)
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use content-visibility:auto to defer rendering of off-screen sections on content-heavy pages (long feeds, dashboards).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception, justified: these are small static server-rendered reference pages (each well under 60KB HTML, no feeds/dashboards/heavy widgets); measured rendering is clean (0 console errors, no long-task evidence in the dual-viewport CDP runs) and the shared editorial design system does not use content-visibility. The applicable half of the guidance — defer off-screen WORK — is already applied via the lazy-loaded, dimensioned CPS iframe. Adding content-visibility would be novelty-chasing against the 'use guidance intelligently' rule, not an evidenced improvement.
